appShell.offlineDescription: Check your connection — you can keep working, and we'll pick back up once you're back online.

errorBoundary.title: Unexpected error
errorBoundary.heading: This screen hit a snag
errorBoundary.description: The current step didn't load correctly. Your install progress is still saved. Try again, or reload the app if it keeps happening.

resumeInstallBanner.title: Resume install in progress
resumeInstallBanner.description: {{chargerId}}, started by {{installerName}}. Pick up where you left off, or dismiss this draft and start a new install.

home.title: Installer
home.subtitle: Scan the charger's QR code or enter its ID to start the install.
home.fieldErrorRequired: Enter a Charger ID or scan the QR code on the charger.

cameraError.insecure-context: The camera only works over HTTPS (or on localhost). You can enter the Charger ID below instead.
cameraError.permission-denied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera access in your browser settings to scan. You can enter the Charger ID below instead.
cameraError.no-camera: No camera was found on this device. You can enter the Charger ID below instead.
cameraError.camera-busy: The camera is being used by another app. Close it and try again. You can enter the Charger ID below instead.
cameraError.unknown: The camera couldn't be started in this browser. You can enter the Charger ID below instead.

home.scanPrompt: Scan the QR code on the charger you are installing
home.pointCamera: Point the camera at the QR code on the charger.

enterTokenId.title: Enter Token ID
enterTokenId.heading: Enter the installer token
enterTokenId.subheading: The app will check the charger, register the token, and find out where to continue.
enterTokenId.installerInvalidWarning: Some installer information is missing or invalid. Go back and check it before continuing.
enterTokenId.tokenIdHelper: Token ID will be provided on the work order.
enterTokenId.statusFetchFailed: Failed to fetch charger status. Please try again later.

installerInformation.title: Installer information
installerInformation.heading: Who's doing this install?
installerInformation.subheading: We'll attach your details to this installation record for the site owner.

siteInformation.title: Site Information
siteInformation.alreadyInstalledDescription: This charger is already installed. Contact support to change these details.
siteInformation.detailsUnavailable: Site area details aren't available for this session.
siteInformation.createNewSiteArea: Can't find your site area? Create new site area

createSiteArea.title: Create Site Area
createSiteArea.heading: Create Site Area
createSiteArea.chooseExisting: Choose an existing site area instead

validateChargerDetails.title: Validate Charger Details
validateChargerDetails.sessionMissing: Your session is missing the installer details. Please cancel and start again.
validateChargerDetails.loadError: Could not load charger details. Please try again.
validateChargerDetails.heading: Validate Charger Details
validateChargerDetails.doNotProceedTitle: Do not proceed if info is incorrect
validateChargerDetails.doNotProceedDescription: If any information is invalid or doesn't match, please contact your CPO for further instructions.

chargerElectricalInformation.title: Charger Electrical Information
chargerElectricalInformation.heading: Charger Electrical Information
chargerElectricalInformation.subheading: Describe the charger's electrical setup. It's checked against the chosen site area.
chargerElectricalInformation.alreadyInstalledDescription: This charger is already installed. Contact support to change these details.
chargerElectricalInformation.noSiteAreaDescription: No site area is selected. Please go back and choose one.
chargerElectricalInformation.ampPerPhaseTooltip: The current draw per phase, in amps, that this charger pulls under full load.

connectorInformationDetails.title: Connector Information Details
connectorInformationDetails.missingSessionDescription: Your session is missing the charger or site details. Please cancel and start again.
connectorInformationDetails.electricalIncompleteDescription: The charger electrical details are incomplete. Please go back and check them.
connectorInformationDetails.submitFailed: Failed to install the charger. Please try again.
connectorInformationDetails.heading: Connector Information Details
connectorInformationDetails.subheading: Describe each connector (plug) on the charger, then submit the whole installation.
connectorInformationDetails.alreadyInstalledDescription: This charger is already installed. Contact support to change these details.

communicationChecklist.title: Communication Checklist
communicationChecklist.noHeartbeatDescription: We have not received a heartbeat signal from this charger.
communicationChecklist.tipHardReset: Perform a hard reset of the charger and wait at least 2 minutes.
communicationChecklist.contactCpo: If the issue persists, contact your CPO at
communicationChecklist.heading: Communication Checklist
communicationChecklist.subheading: Refer to the installation manual and tick completed tasks below.
communicationChecklist.allCheckedStatus: All items checked. You can continue.

physicalHealthiness.title: Physical Healthiness
physicalHealthiness.heading: Physical Healthiness
physicalHealthiness.allCheckedStatus: All items checked. You can continue.
physicalHealthiness.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please start again.

automatedOcppTesting.title: Automated OCPP Testing
automatedOcppTesting.ocppTestingFailedDescription: We couldn't complete the OCPP test. Please check your network communication.
automatedOcppTesting.contactSupport: If the problem persists, contact your support team at
automatedOcppTesting.heading: Automated OCPP Testing
automatedOcppTesting.subheading: These checks run automatically once you continue.

processing.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please start again.
processing.stayMessage: Please stay on this screen while we complete the process. This may take a few minutes. Do not close or navigate away from the app.

readyToBeCommissioned.toastMessage: {{chargerId}} commissioning complete. Charger is now live.
readyToBeCommissioned.title: Ready to be commissioned
readyToBeCommissioned.subheading: Charger is Ready for Commissioning. Thank you for completing the installation steps successfully.

readyToCharge.title: Ready to Charge
readyToCharge.description: To start charging, download the DynaChrg PayG app from the App Store or Google Play.

installationSuccess.title: Installation Success
installationSuccess.heading: Charger successfully installed
installationSuccess.description: Congratulations on successfully completing all the setup steps! You can now proceed to the Communication Checklist to ensure everything is connected and ready for use.

noEvChargerFound.title: No EV Charger Found
noEvChargerFound.description: We couldn't find this charger. Check the Charger ID and Token ID, or scan a different QR code.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: That address doesn't match a step in the install flow. Head back to the start and pick up from there.

chargerCommissioned.title: Charger already commissioned
chargerCommissioned.description: This charger has already been commissioned and is live. No further setup is needed.

chargerUnavailable.title: Charger unavailable
chargerUnavailable.description: This charger is reporting a fault and can't be installed right now. Contact support for help.
